front.title: SCHC No-ACK Fragmentation of VXLAN Payloads

abstract.t: This document proposes a SCHC No-ACK profile for carrying VXLAN payloads, including those larger than the path MTU, over a managed UDP path. On a configured peer association every frame is carried as a SCHC Packet made of a NoCompress rule identifier, the uncompressed VXLAN header and the Ethernet frame. The packet is sent unfragmented when it fits the path MTU and fragmented otherwise. A four-bit fragment counter supports up to eight fragments. An optional receiver procedure for reordering is described separately because it changes the RFC 8724 No-ACK receiver behavior. The earlier indexed fragmentation proposal is retained in an appendix for comparison. The mapping and operational parameters require working group review.
